WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) as total_count
  FROM telescope_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.count,
    tc.count * 1.0 / t.total_count as share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN total t
  WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  s.observstation,
  s.count,
  s.share,
  s.share - a.avg_share as difference
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
